# P16 Performance and scale

- Requirement: Required for performance requests. Also required for other types when measurements determine adoption of an option or completion
- Placement: The relevant discussion in the body
- Narrative role: Explains the key figures and interpretation needed for performance judgments.
- Author: Person able to measure and proposer of the result
- Reviewer: The executor confirms measurement and interpretation; the consumer confirms required user outcomes and acceptance criteria
- Check: Are local and production, measured and expected, and single-run and distribution figures distinguished? Are correctness, cost and sample conditions included?

<!-- body:start -->
## Current cost and target

We want to improve [latency, size or processing cost] under [usage conditions]. If measurements exist, explain [key values and units, time, environment, and whether measured or estimated] within the confirmed or reported scope, and link conditions and records in endnotes. If the material contains no results, leave results unconfirmed; if execution is unknown, do not assert that no measurement was performed. If actual nonmeasurement is confirmed, state that and leave needed measurements as [conditions and questions].

The required user outcome is [result]. The target [figure or condition] is [newly proposed, under review or agreed], and [correctness, permissions, data meaning or other costs] must be preserved. Unchecked [conditions] limit [the scope that can be judged].

Once [owner] confirms [comparison under the same conditions and review time], we can decide [next choice]. An existing measurement report or previously agreed figure is not required.
